_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ị na-egwu Klondike Solitaire. Ọrụ gị bụ ịkwaga kaadị niile gaa na ihe ndị mkpali.

Egwuregwu:
- Ihe mkpali (F1-F4): Wụnye site na Ace ruo King na uwe
- Ihe ndị a na-egwu (T1-T7): Wụnye ala na-aga n'ihu na-acha ọbara ọbara na oji
- Ọgbụgba: Kọwaa kaadị gaa na ihe mkpofu
- Ihe mkpofu (W): Kaadị dị n'elu dị maka egwuregwu

Ịdịri:
- 'draw' - Kọwaa kaadị site na ọgbụgba gaa na ihe mkpofu
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Kwaga kaadị n'etiti ihe ndị a na-egwu
  Ọmụmaatụ: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count nwekwara ike ịbụ 'all', nke ga-agbalị ịkwaga kaadị niile dị n'ihu.
- 'forfeit' - Kwụsị egwuregwu ozugbo na kọọ akara gị ugbu a
- Aha ihe ndị a na-egwu: W (ihe mkpofu), F1-F4 (ihe mkpali), T1-T7 (ihe ndị a na-egwu)

Ị nwere ike ịrụ ọtụtụ ihe n'otu egwuregwu site na kewaa ha na commas:
  Ọmụmaatụ: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Naanị Eze nwere ike ịbụ ebe a na-etinye na ihe ndị a na-egwu efu.
Ihe ịrụ ga-agbaso usoro - ọ bụrụ na otu dara, ndị fọdụrụ ga-atụgharị.
Jiri 'forfeit' ọ bụrụ na ị kwenyere na egwuregwu ahụ adịghị mma ịmeri.

format_error.no_brackets: Ọdịdị ihe na-abaghị uru. Ihe kwesịrị ịdị n'etiti parentheses.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Ọkpụkpọ ihe na-abaghị uru. Enweghị mmechi mmechi ']'
format_error.empty_command: Ịdịri efu. Dere 'draw' ma ọ bụ 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.move_needs_args: Iwu mbugharị chọrọ isi mmalite na ebe njedebe. Ojiji: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Ọnụ ọgụgụ kwesịrị ịbụ chanya ma ọ bụ 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ezighi ezi. Jiri nọmba ma ọ bụ 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Ịdịri amaghị '{cmd}'. Jiri 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', ma ọ bụ 'forfeit'
